svg.aria-label: Global API: invoice exchange, one executor and recoverable outcomes
svg.title: Global API: invoice exchange, one executor and recoverable outcomes
svg.desc: Proposed design. Customer send, inbound ingest and provider execution use separate permissions within one API contract. Solid arrows: owned request or result. Dashed: evidence, event or recovery. API receipt, notification acknowledgement and buyer acceptance remain separate. Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec. Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec.

Proposed design. Customer send, inbound ingest and provider execution use separate permissions within one API contract. Solid arrows: owned request or result. Dashed: evidence, event or recovery. API receipt, notification acknowledgement and buyer acceptance remain separate.
